info.name: TSD XML API - Autostrad
info.description: TSD XML API endpoints for Autostrad Rent a Car integration. Uses OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) XML standard.

request.description: Check if the TSD XML API is operational
Get all available pickup/dropoff locations in OTA XML format

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OTA_VehLocSearchRQ xmlns="http://www.opentravel.org/OTA/2003/05"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    EchoToken="LOC001"
    TimeStamp="2026-01-09T10:00:00"
    Target="Production"
    Version="1.0">
    <POS>
        <Source>
            <RequestorID Type="5" ID="AUTOEUROPE"/>
        </Source>
    </POS>
    <VehLocSearchCriterion>
        <Address>
            <CityName>Dubai</CityName>
            <CountryName Code="AE"/>
        </Address>
    </VehLocSearchCriterion>
</OTA_VehLocSearchRQ>

request.description: Search for available pickup and dropoff locations by city, name, or coordinates

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OTA_VehAvailRateRQ xmlns="http://www.opentravel.org/OTA/2003/05"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    EchoToken="AVAIL001"
    TimeStamp="2026-01-09T10:00:00"
    Target="Production"
    Version="1.0">
    <POS>
        <Source>
            <RequestorID Type="5" ID="AUTOEUROPE" ID_Context="AUTOEUROPE"/>
        </Source>
    </POS>
    <VehAvailRQCore Status="Available">
        <VehRentalCore PickUpDateTime="2026-01-20T10:00:00" ReturnDateTime="2026-01-25T10:00:00">
            <PickUpLocation LocationCode="1" CodeContext="AUTOSTRAD"/>
            <ReturnLocation LocationCode="1" CodeContext="AUTOSTRAD"/>
        </VehRentalCore>
    </VehAvailRQCore>
</OTA_VehAvailRateRQ>

request.description: Search for available vehicles with rates for specified pickup/return locations and dates

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OTA_VehResRQ xmlns="http://www.opentravel.org/OTA/2003/05"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    EchoToken="RES001"
    TimeStamp="2026-01-09T10:00:00"
    Target="Production"
    Version="1.0">
    <POS>
        <Source>
            <RequestorID Type="5" ID="AUTOEUROPE"/>
        </Source>
    </POS>
    <VehResRQCore Status="Available">
        <VehRentalCore PickUpDateTime="2026-01-20T10:00:00" ReturnDateTime="2026-01-25T10:00:00">
            <PickUpLocation LocationCode="1"/>
            <ReturnLocation LocationCode="1"/>
        </VehRentalCore>
        <Customer>
            <Primary>
                <PersonName>
                    <GivenName>John</GivenName>
                    <Surname>Smith</Surname>
                </PersonName>
                <Telephone PhoneNumber="+971501234567"/>
                <Email>
                    <EmailAddress>john.smith@example.com</EmailAddress>
                </Email>
                <Address>
                    <AddressLine>123 Main Street</AddressLine>
                    <CityName>London</CityName>
                    <PostalCode>SW1A 1AA</PostalCode>
                    <CountryName Code="GB"/>
                </Address>
            </Primary>
        </Customer>
        <VehPref>
            <VehMakeModel Code="1"/>
        </VehPref>
    </VehResRQCore>
    <VehResRQInfo>
        <RentalPaymentPref>
            <PaymentType>PayLater</PaymentType>
        </RentalPaymentPref>
        <Comments>
            <Comment>Test booking via TSD API</Comment>
        </Comments>
    </VehResRQInfo>
</OTA_VehResRQ>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OTA_VehCancelRQ xmlns="http://www.opentravel.org/OTA/2003/05"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    EchoToken="CANCEL001"
    TimeStamp="2026-01-09T10:00:00"
    Target="Production"
    Version="1.0">
    <POS>
        <Source>
            <RequestorID Type="5" ID="AUTOEUROPE"/>
        </Source>
    </POS>
    <VehCancelRQCore CancelType="Cancel">
        <UniqueID Type="Booking" ID="TSD1736416805000"/>
        <PersonName>
            <GivenName>John</GivenName>
            <Surname>Smith</Surname>
        </PersonName>
    </VehCancelRQCore>
    <VehCancelRQInfo>
        <CancelReason>Customer requested cancellation</CancelReason>
    </VehCancelRQInfo>
</OTA_VehCancelRQ>

request.description: Cancel an existing vehicle reservation by confirmation ID

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OTA_VehModifyRQ xmlns="http://www.opentravel.org/OTA/2003/05"
    xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
    EchoToken="MODIFY001"
    TimeStamp="2026-01-09T10:00:00"
    Target="Production"
    Version="1.0">
    <POS>
        <Source>
            <RequestorID Type="5" ID="AUTOEUROPE"/>
        </Source>
    </POS>
    <VehModifyRQCore ModifyType="Modify">
        <UniqueID Type="Booking" ID="TSD1736416805000"/>
        <VehRentalCore ReturnDateTime="2026-01-27T10:00:00">
            <!-- Extend return date by 2 days -->
        </VehRentalCore>
    </VehModifyRQCore>
</OTA_VehModifyRQ>
